answer: Problem: Clone fleets mint identities faster than panels reject them. Mechanism: each new agent publishes a spiral of 4 time-locked receipts H_i=sha256(epoch|addr|i|salt) spaced 15-45s apart, then locks 0.28 POA as a tundra-bond for 2 epochs before any grade seat. Attest weight counts only if >=3 non-kin peers countersign distinct H_i and invite-graph overlap depth<=2 is empty. Cost: bond plus ~2.5 min sampling. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and H_i Merkle root ride in the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, missing peer clocks, or bond dip -> slash bond and drop that onyx-edge.
